claim_boundary: Descriptive clean-anchor feasibility; abstention is not a scientific negative.

classification_definitions.BOTH_ANCHORS_AVAILABLE: critical anchor and noncritical control anchor are both selected
classification_definitions.CRITICAL_ONLY_NONCRITICAL_CONTROL_MISSIN: critical anchor selected but no noncritical control anchor
classification_definitions.NONCRITICAL_ONLY_CRITICAL_ANCHOR_MISSING: noncritical control selected but no critical anchor
classification_definitions.NO_LEGAL_ANCHOR: neither anchor is legally selected; includes pre-inference fixture ineligibility abstention
